scope: Seven current authored sources, all fifteen packed combinations, and five superseded master/mouth images
user_feedback: Nose and mouth perspective is wrong; the head reads as an unserious cartoon
shared_failures: Skull and brow imply a turned head, while the nose does not convincingly project from that same facial plane
Mouth placement and corner recession do not consistently follow the facial centreline and muzzle volume
Bulbous brow and cheek forms, rounded block-like chin, glossy highlights and upturned lips create a caricature
Variant prompts locked the faulty master geometry while changing only local openings

current_sources.guardian-bare-master: Rejected: inconsistent nose/mouth construction and a smirking neutral expression

current_sources.mouth-cut-medium: Rejected: opening broadens the smile without resolving the face plane or far-corner recession
current_sources.mouth-cut-wide: Rejected: exaggerated grin and insufficiently convincing jaw motion within the fixed silhouette
current_sources.mouth-cut-oval: Rejected: aperture reads as a separate oval on the near cheek, left of the facial centreline
current_sources.eyes-half: Blink patch is technically usable, but the overall head remains rejected and needs a new base
current_sources.eyes-closed: Blink patch is technically usable, but the overall head remains rejected and needs a new base

superseded_sources.master: Same construction and tone problems, plus the rejected trophy mount
superseded_sources.small_medium_wide: Same construction problems; teeth and tongue also violate the user's art requirements
superseded_sources.round: Especially inconsistent perspective; pursed frontal lips contradict the turned head

next_art_gate: Rebuild and review one structurally coherent, stern master at native and enlarged scales before producing animation variants
